intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Tortellini-salad and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Tortellini salad may pose a gluten risk due to the use of traditional pasta made from wheat flour. Additionally, cross-contamination during preparation can further increase the risk for those with coeliac disease.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Tortellini-salad can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.

faq.question: What should I ask a restaurant?
